appointmentFacts.bookingGuidance: Patients can request an appointment through the Silwadi contact page or contact reception. Reception can guide patients to an appropriate dentist or specialist based on the reason for the visit.
appointmentFacts.insuranceGuidance: Insurance acceptance, direct billing and covered dental benefits can vary by provider and plan. Reception must confirm the current process for a patient's specific policy.
appointmentFacts.liveAvailability: Not available to the AI assistant. Reception must confirm current appointment availability.
appointmentFacts.pricing: Not available to the AI assistant unless a future approved live source is connected. Reception must confirm current fees.

clinicFactRules: For clinic-specific facts, use only information present in this file.
If a clinic-specific fact is absent, say that reception needs to confirm it.
